reason: This article is a Crunchbase analysis of Nvidia/NVentures' startup investment activity, not an announcement of a funding round. The rounds it mentions (OpenAI Series G, Anthropic Series G, Crusoe Series F, Mistral AI Series D, Skild AI Series C, Waabi Series C, Bedrock Robotics Series B and C, Aidoc Series E) are referenced as past deals in which Nvidia participated; the article does not announce or close them, and several are non-US (Mistral AI is French). No qualifying US AI funding round is announced here.
